pr_title: Replay recording extension until results screen transition
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/22493

Works similarly to stable.

Replay ends when:
- player presses the Escape (`GlobalAction.Back`) key
- player skips storyboard ending
- one second (`Player.RESULTS_DISPLAY_DELAY`) after last `HitObject`
- one second (`Player.RESULTS_DISPLAY_DELAY`) after storyboard ending
pr_comments:
I've made some further changes to hopefully make the whole process easier to follow.

I do think it's also feasible to replace the `resultsDisplayDelegate` logic with an `async` invocation instead (with one initially delayed schedule), but don't want to do that in this PR as there are other locations in `Player` which cancel that process, and I want to avoid breaking them.

I'm pretty happy with this now, but will need a double-check to make sure it feels good @ppy/team-client.

issue_context.title: Replay recording should continue to record until the results screen transition
issue_context.body:
I agree that this is behaviour we want to keep around. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/22481
Originally posted by **monochrome22** February 1, 2023 One thing that always bothered me in lazer is that replays end immediately after pressing the last object. In stable, it will continue recording for a few seconds, until the player goes to the results screen. Often during the few seconds after the map ends, players do movements with their cursors or even use smoke. Here are some examples: (rrtyui) [https://youtu.be/17PP3XB1IzM?t=131](https://youtu.be/17PP3XB1IzM?t=131) (skip to 2:11) (Bikko) [https://youtu.be/xQmuYsXmBH4?t=135](https://youtu.be/xQmuYsXmBH4?t=135) (skip to 2:15) (Cookiezi) [https://youtu.be/86pK4kJ1v_g?t=55](https://youtu.be/86pK4kJ1v_g?t=55) (skip to 0:55) (aetrna) [https://youtu.be/hJmXbwF55rM?t=195](https://youtu.be/hJmXbwF55rM?t=195) (skip to 3:15) While this is how it works in lazer: [https://youtu.be/H2FeD34Pfew?t=85](https://youtu.be/H2FeD34Pfew?t=85) (skip to 1:25) I feel that the movements that players do at the end of the replay add charm and personality to both the player and the play. I always thought it's cool how rrtyui flicks his cursor to the top of his screen, and seeing Bikko do that smooth curve after spinner adds a sense of calmness to his plays. Having the replay end immediately takes these away and makes it more dull. I don't have suggestions on exactly how it should be implemented. Just have it record for a few extra seconds or until players goes to results screen.

review_comments:
Should I be worried that this is changing `Drawable` states via calling `.Expire()` internally, yet it runs on a TPL thread when the button's clicked from the results screen?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1329837/223923959-61ccc490-0bf2-4f82-965e-9ce4f058e69f.png)

It's pretty dodge when you look at it that way, but the `null` path at most [calls `Expire()` on a drawable](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/7bc8908ca9c026fed1d831eb6e58df7624a8d614/osu.Game/Rulesets/UI/RulesetInputManager.cs#L45) so i guess it's mostly safe...
Isn't this going to run multiple times? This delegate is looping.

Potentially yes in cases where the the `beginScoreImport` returns on the if check. I don't necessarily see it as an issue because it is essentially behaving as before, and the `Scheduler` might stop working soon once the screen exits (not sure about this behavior). If desired for the `canShowResults` check can be used at the beginning of `progressToResults` as well.
Maybe an easier option would be to cancel the looping delegate when the if check returns.
I dunno, I can't follow this logic. Like why is this only run when the task is null? There's too much missing detail which makes it hard to follow the changes.
